name: אָזְנִי
summary: A son of Gad and head of the clan of the Oznites (Num 26:16), who stands in the list of Gad's sons where Gen 46:16 has Ezbon. The name is אֹזֶן with “my”: “my ear”, perhaps “(God has heard) my ear”, but scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Of אָזְנִי, the clan of the Oznite (הָאָזְנִי).”
The sons of Gad: “Ziphion and Haggi, Shuni and Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli”: Ezbon stands where Num 26:16 has Ozni.

note: Takes a.cg.ae (the name) and a.cg.af (the gentilic הָאָזְנִי); the brief counts the same two tokens under both. TIPNR records Ozni and Oznite as forms of Ezbon@Gen.46.16. Why Gad's son has two names is not explained; the meaning 'my ear' is a reading of the form only.
